basis: Absent kidneys cause oligohydramnios and pulmonary hypoplasia in 80-99%. Cardiac and intestinal malformations are associated defects, not direct consequences.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: associated cardiac malformations are not direct consequences of renal agenesis, despite the 30-79% annotation
decisions.gastrointestinal: none: intestinal malformations and fistulas are associated developmental defects, not direct consequences of renal agenesis

basis: Smooth-surface caries destroys dental hard tissue through biofilm-driven acid demineralization; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: caries is a biofilm-mediated dysbiotic disease; bacterial acid production alone does not establish an infection or immune-mediated disorder

basis: Mandibular skeletal malposition and dental malocclusion define the disease; open bite occurs in 80-99%. Craniosynostosis is occasional.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: dental malocclusion is the supplied definition, with open bite in 80-99%; teeth and dental occlusion belong to this axis

basis: HLA-I expression deficiency causes immunodeficiency; destructive granulomatous skin ulcers occur in roughly 40-50%. Secondary respiratory infections are separate diseases.

decisions.dermatologic: involved: chronic destructive granulomatous skin ulcers affect roughly 40-50% and represent direct immune dysregulation

basis: Alveolar hemorrhage defines pulmonary disease. Anemia in 30-79% reflects blood loss, not direct blood-cell or marrow injury; autoimmune causes are separate underlying diseases.

decisions.haematologic: none: anemia occurs in 30-79% but results from pulmonary blood loss; the syndrome does not directly damage blood cells, marrow or coagulation

basis: Axonal neuropathy affects 4/4. Amyotrophy in 2/4 reflects denervation, not direct muscle disease; individual skeletal deformities occur in 1/4.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: muscle atrophy in 2/4 is secondary to denervation; structural skeletal deformities each occur in only 1/4, below 30%

basis: Contractures and kyphoscoliosis occur in 2/2 assessed, as do astigmatism and esotropia. Microtia and superficial skin/nail findings lack demonstrated functional injury.

decisions.otologic: none: microtia is reported in 2/2 assessed, but external-ear dysmorphism alone does not demonstrate hearing, vestibular or other functional damage

basis: Inherited iron overload characteristically targets liver; iron-related arthropathy affects roughly 30-50% in hereditary hemochromatosis. Digenic-specific frequencies are uncertain.

decisions.hepatic: primary: characteristic hepatic iron accumulation and injury are central to the hereditary hemochromatosis phenotype
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: iron-related structural arthropathy affects roughly 30-50% in hereditary hemochromatosis; digenic-specific data are limited

basis: Congenital limb absence defines the skeletal disorder; the supplied full syndrome synonym also identifies pulmonary hypoplasia as a defining malformation.

decisions.pulmonary: primary: the supplied syndrome synonym explicitly includes pulmonary hypoplasia; the definition does not contradict this defining feature

basis: P5CS deficiency manifests as progressive spastic paraplegia; structural pes cavus occurs in 30-79%. Cataracts and elbow contractures occur in only 5-29%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: persistent structural pes cavus occurs in 30-79%, establishing skeletal deformity beyond weakness or spasticity alone
